message: The other day, I found myself in our family group chat with my kids, sharing a little giggle about our go-bags. I had just checked mine and realized I’d packed three different kinds of snacks—whoops! 🍫 While we joked about my snack obsession, it reminded me how important it is to be prepared, not just with essentials but also with a plan. Keeping the conversation light helps us all feel more ready for anything that comes our way. Have you checked your go-bag lately?
